expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第7–17天共用传动链的两根丝杠转矩同时上升。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 7–17: torque of both ball screws on the shared drive chain rises simultaneously.

ground_truth.zh: 传动链 M01-DC1 摩擦 +0.5（线性）。

expected_health_response.zh: 两根丝杠均 WARNING；证据融合应提示共同原因（传动链），不应各自判定为丝杠磨损。
expected_health_response.en: Both ball screws WARNING; evidence fusion should indicate a common cause (drive chain) rather than separate ball-screw wear.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.

limitations.zh: 转矩升高只说明负载/摩擦变化，不能单独证明丝杠磨损。
limitations.en: Higher torque indicates a load/friction change; it does not alone prove ball-screw wear.
